gerard_established_by: Title: 'Oeuvre 39 ... 2e livraison'. Pleyel's 'Douze quatuors, oeuvre 39' in four livraisons of three. The livraison-to-Gerard mapping is the one established by hand from the Berlin, Munich and Rochester copies and recorded in corrections.json under 990005884.

rism_related_established_by: This copy is not in RISM -- it was found on a library portal. These are RISM's records for the same print of the same works (GerB 214, 215, 233), matched on the title; the Gérard numbers differ because RISM numbers this edition as a whole while this folder carries the livraison's own. They describe the edition, not this copy.
